segments.name: Railroad
segments.description: Operates a Class I freight railroad serving customers across the western two-thirds of the United States, with connections to Canada and Mexico.
segments.evidence: The Railroad, along with its subsidiaries and rail affiliates, is our one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Union Pacific freight revenues to transport commodities across its rail network, reported across Bulk, Industrial, and Premium commodity groups.
revenueModel.evidence: In 2025, we generated freight revenues totaling $23.2 billion from the following three commodity groups: 2025 Freight Revenues
